coverage.screeningMeaning: Whole-registry kind/topic/headline screening reconciled with prior evidence; not 1056 freshly fetched primary dossiers or an assertion that every optional topic is exhaustive.
coverage.readMethod: Read-only public organisation fields from production, reconciled by unique ID. An initially incomplete tool response was detected by count checks; 93 missing IDs were fetched separately, followed by the latest three additions. Final unique-ID count is 1056.

policy: Company/startup eligibility requires substantive continuing original or jointly developed relevant technology, without exclusive IP or patent requirements; client-only custom implementations are insufficient.
Investor topics describe explicit investment mandates, not portfolio companies or investor-owned products.
climate-tech is the stable key for Energy, not all sustainability or environmental activity.
Store specific descendants without redundant ancestors; broad parent filters already include descendants.
Topicless broad institutions and investors need not be assigned invented specialties.
